name: Workyard Upstairs Teaching Hearth Family v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Cooking and firemaking hearth with lesson furniture and cozy flame socket
review_note: The Blender family retains the reference-defining irregular stone arch, deep full-cavity soot back, hand-hewn mantle and corbels, crossed fuel, three-layer fire, crane/chain/kettle, compact shovel-and-brush set, six-sided kindling lesson table, two deliberately different stools, and octagonal hearth rug. The canonical player proves the architectural hearth is large without becoming giant-scaled.
improve: Use the slow runtime flame motion and warm point light; preserve the dark cavity coverage and keep the fireplace tool stand clear of nearby props.
